item.title: 【HD Live Performances】UPSCALE - [REQ VID] Madonna - The Re-Invention Tour 2004 (Dan-K 2026 HD Restoration)
item.description:
Dan-K is a very well-known Madonna fan and remaster, in fact he does some of the best remasters out there of her content.

Problem is that when it comes to this Re-Invention Tour remaster, as with the Girlie Show Tour one, it is only available through physical format which he's selling on his website - and not only I don't have a blu-ray player but also it would be VERY expensive to import it.

Also, not only I would pay the 85 euros for it but also the taxes when it arrives in Brazil. Just for you guys to get it, based o
on a recent average Euro exchange rate of approximately R$ 6.13:
  • Customs Value (85€): ~R$ 521.15
  • Import Tax (60%): R$ 312.69
  • Subtotal with federal tax: R$ 833.84
  • ICMS Calculation (17% grossed-up): R$ 833.84 ÷ 0.83 = R$ 1,004.63
  • (The ICMS tax amount alone comes to R$ 170.79)
  • Total Accumulated Taxes: R$ 483.48
  • Estimated Total Cost: ~R$ 1,019.63 (Product + Taxes + R$ 15.00 Postal Fee)
In total, the final tax burden is approximately 92.8% on top of the original value in Brazilian Reais.

The current Brazilian federal minimum wage is R$ 1,621.00.
  • The estimated total cost of this order (R$ 1,019.63) is equivalent to 62.9% of a full monthly minimum wage.

  • To put it into perspective, a worker earning the national floor would have to spend nearly 19 days of labor just to pay for this single 85€ international order and its associated taxes.

Unfortunately, that is unreal for me right now and I can't afford it. So I'm kindly asking, if you have bought this remaster, could you please share it? It would mean a lot to me.
